'''Hennilrum''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who worked the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|spacelanes]] of [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sympathetic toward the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Hennilrum used his connections with [[Treffelt Wuin]] to leak information on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Bissillirus Resupply Base|supply base]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]].
